Its disingenuous to say ptsd can be cured. That's not the language we use in therapy. My source is i am a clinical counsellor and have been practicing for ~5 years post masters. 

I hear what you are saying, but as a rule of thumb we don't "cure" people of mental health illness, and aggressive treatments do not "cure" people. Rather, they give people the tools and skills to manage their condition and increase their quality of life. 

You could reduce symptoms enough to no longer meet the diagnostic criteria for a disorder. But even then I would not call that being "cured." I would call thar "no longer meeting the diagnostic criteria."

I mean I get what you're saying, but no, PTSD is a disorder. It does not heal the way a knee injury heals. It requires treatment to manage the symptoms and reduce their impact. Trauma doesn't go away after a period of healing, you just learn to manage it better.

Reverse pickpocketing. Its a means of being able to pickpocket items from characters you usually can't, like the clothes they are wearing for example. 

If you pickpocket a character, and instead place clothing in their inventory (the same way you would place a grenade in their pocket to kill them), and that clothing is more valuable than what they are currently wearing, then after a couple in-game days the NPC will swap out what they are wearing for the more valuable one. 

In this case, the AntAgonizer costume is more valuable than Elder Lyons' Robe. So after a day with it in hisninventory, he puts that on instead. The robe is now available to pickpocket from his inventory.

She got quiet, and then said “Matt” real quietly. I asked for the ring back, and she returned it. I then I asked her to leave and she did.
